notes:
AJIO Home (Home & Kitchen vertical, ajio.com). Access: tier-1 HTTP (curl_cffi) worked throughout using mobile TLS fingerprints (chrome99_android for /s/ SSR search-PLP pages, safari17_2_ios for /home-kitchen/c/8312 which 403'd on chrome99_android) - matches prior-pass notes that desktop fingerprints are Akamai-blocked on this host. AJIO's homepage and several nav-linked pages (/shop/fresh-arrivals, /shop/sale, /capsule/newin) have migrated since the prior Home-Decor pass to a new client-rendered 'Fynd' CMS storefront shell (no SSR product data, window.APP_DATA CMS config only) - needed tier-2 Playwright; default Chromium was Akamai-blocked, but WebKit+iPhone-13 device emulation got through (confirmed a real 200 render, not just app-shell HTML).

Navigation discovery performed: (1) main/mega nav and 'Shop By' quick-nav extracted from embedded window.APP_DATA on multiple SSR pages - contains Sale/Men/Women/Kids and a top-level 'New Arrivals' item (->/shop/fresh-arrivals) and 'Collections' item (->/capsule/newin), no Bestsellers item anywhere in any nav tree. (2) footer nav (seo-footer-nav) - policy/help links only, no category links. (3) robots.txt sitemap index (https://www.ajio.com/cms/sitemap/rilfnl/sitemap.xml.gz) fully walked: the genuine backend CATEGORY sitemap (~150 nodes, full Home & Kitchen subtree incl. Home-Kitchen-Decor-Gifting/Lighting/Mirrors/Photo-Frames/Vases/Wall-Table-Decor/Furniture etc, matching the prior pass's taxonomy) has zero nodes named Bestseller/Clearance/Outlet/New-Arrival/Trending anywhere in the whole file, decor-related or not. The WEBCATEGORY marketing-collection sitemap (16,764 /c/ URLs) and the CURATED marketing-collection sitemap (256,652 /s/ URLs) were both regex-scanned for (bestseller|best-sell|new-arriv|clearance|outlet|trending|popular|top-sell) combined with any Home/decor keyword (home, decor, furniture, lighting, mirror, vase, showpiece, planter, wallart, tableware, curtain, cushion, rug, lamp, diya, candle, etc) - zero matches in either file. Thousands of bestseller/clearance/newarrivals-named entries DO exist in these sitemaps but every one sampled is a per-brand or per-apparel-category marketing campaign (e.g. best-seller-nike, crocs-bestsellers, ajio-clearance, bottomwear-clearance-sale, newarrivals tied to fashion brands) - none scoped to Home & Kitchen. (4) Opened the Home & Kitchen department root PLP (https://www.ajio.com/home-kitchen/c/8312, 351,128 items total) directly: it exposes 'New'/'BESTSELLER'/'Bestseller' only as arbitrary tag-facet FILTERS layered onto the undifferentiated full department (e.g. ?q=:relevance:tags:BESTSELLER, count=3396; tags:Bestseller, count=421) - these are badge-driven query filters, not a distinct site-defined/nav-linked Bestsellers page, and they span the entire Home&Kitchen department (kitchen appliances, bath, bedding etc), not a genuine merchandising PLP - excluded per brief SS3 (arbitrary filter pages / badge-on-product signal only). Sampled two Home-decor category SSR pages directly (/s/tablelamps-341927, /s/showpieces-341925) for any embedded Home-specific bestseller widget - none found, only the generic sitewide nav boilerplate. Site search (/search) was not used - robots.txt explicitly disallows /search and /*/search/* (general bot-etiquette disallow, not Claude-specific; respected as the prior pass did), and the exhaustive sitemap enumeration above substitutes for it per SS4 guidance.

Conclusion: no genuine Home-vertical Bestsellers PLP exists on AJIO as a distinct, nav-or-sitemap-discoverable listing separate from ordinary category browsing or its own per-product 'BESTSELLER' badge/tag filter.
